about: The introitus of the formulary “Ascension of the Lord” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Men of Galilee, why do you marvel, looking up to heaven? Alleluia. As you have seen Him ascending into heaven, so He will come, alleluia, alleluia, alleluia. All you nations, clap your hands; shout to God with a voice of exultation. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen. Men of Galilee, why do you marvel, looking up to heaven? Alleluia. As you have seen Him ascending into heaven, so He will come, alleluia, alleluia, alleluia.
